# A dust cloud (generated by make_env.py), origin on the ground.
new
material new DustCloud --base-color 0.651 0.635 0.588 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.32 --location 0.750 0.000 0.30
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.40 --location 0.468 0.235 0.45
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.48 --location -0.167 0.292 0.30
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.32 --location -0.676 0.130 0.45
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.40 --location -0.676 -0.130 0.30
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.48 --location -0.167 -0.292 0.45
material assign DustCloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Cloud6 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.32 --location 0.468 -0.235 0.30
material assign DustCloud
select all
shade flat
export dust.glb
